messages:
olivia_sales: Quick sync: Prospect (FirstBank) wants a 7-day air-gapped POC. Key asks: vendor bundle with SBOM + detached sig, ability for customer to re-sign with their Thales HSM, time-limited handoff cert + attestation PDF, resume-able USB chunks, offline license activation (no outbound), and a fixed monthly offline pool quote. Can we confirm deliverables + PS hours?

mike_se: We can produce bundle.tar.gz + bundle.sig + bundle_manifest.json (sha256s). For re-signing by customerno integration work. If Redwood must call their HSM (proxy) to sign at handoff, estimate ~3 eng days + 1 ops day + test harness (quote as PS).

zoe_sre: For resume-able USB: we support chunk_N.tar.gz with index.json. We'll supply verify_and_join.sh to validate per-chunk sha256, reassemble atomically, then validate top-level signature. Recommend retaining previous bundle artifacts (keep last 2) for rollback. Maintenance windows: small patch (single chunk) 30-60m; full rollout 2-5h depending on USB copy speed.

han_security: FirstBank requires FIPS-compatible signing and an auditable signing event. We can provide: (A) customer re-sign (recommended), (B) Redwood sign via customer HSM proxy (audited), or (C) vendor sign + signed attestation PDF. Time-limited certs are doable but require ops to provision a short-lived signing cert or provide an HSM proxy endpoint. I'll draft questionnaire language and FIPS wording.

mike_se: Quick verify snippet to hand them:

```
# validate assembled bundle
./verify_and_join.sh --index index.json --chunks /mnt/usb
# verify signature
cosign verify --key redwood_vendor.pub bundle.tar.gz.sig
# sanity check SBOM presence
jq -e '.sbom' bundle_manifest.json
```

olivia_sales: Licensing: they want an offline activation file with no outbound call. Do we offer that?

mike_se: Yes  we can produce activation.jwt signed by Redwood. If they want Redwood to sign activation tokens with their HSM, add PS (2-4 days). For customer-managed activation we provide instructions to re-sign activation.jwt locally.

zoe_sre: Rollback note: rollback supported only if previous bundles preserved locally. We'll add atomic swap steps: stage->verify->swap. If swap fails, automatic revert to previous bundle. Include smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Ticket SLS-99988 created: "FirstBank air-gapped POC : handoff certs, USB chunks, offline activation" by olivia_sales.

han_security: I'll prepare questionnaire answers and sample attestation wording by Monday EOD.

mike_se: I'll draft PS scoping + cost bands for (1) standard POC, (2) POC + HSM proxy signing, (3) add-on: time-limited cert orchestration.

olivia_sales: Great. Targets: mike -> PS scoping + ballpark by Mon; zoe -> runbook excerpt + verify_and_join script by Mon; han -> questionnaire + FIPS wording by Mon. Send full package to customer Tue AM. :thumbsup:
